---
title: Local and Remote Architecture
---

# Local and Remote Architecture

`RecapClient` presents one Python API over two backend arrangements.

Local clients use SQLite and `LocalBackend` for reads and writes. Remote clients
use GraphQL for reads and `RESTAdapter` for writes. Both arrangements preserve
the same schemas, namespace context, builder API, and command semantics.
Calling `client.namespace(path)` creates a scoped `RecapClient` view without
opening a second backend connection; views share connection state and can be
closed independently.

Remote writes enter through thin FastAPI routes and then pass through
`CommandService`. The command layer owns authorization, one transaction,
optimistic revision checks, idempotency, and audit outcomes. This keeps HTTP
transport separate from mutation behavior.
